cleavage_agent.evidence: Samples were diluted 4 folds with 50 mM Tris-HCl, pH 8.0 and digested with Lys-C (Wako) at 1:50 enzyme‐to‐substrate ratio at 25 ºC for 2 h.
The same amount of sequencing-grade modified trypsin (Promega, Madison, WI) was added to the samples for 14 h incubation at 25 °C.

collision_energy.evidence: Tandem mass spectra of top 12 most intense ions (excluding singly charged molecules) were collected with high-energy collision induced dissociation (HCD) fragmentation (2.0 m/z isolation width; 30% normalized collision energy; 17,500 resolution at 400 m/z).

fractionation_method.evidence: Peptides were labeled with 11-plex tandem mass tag (TMT, Thermo Fisher Scientific) and fractionated into 24 fractions by high pH reverse phase chromatography (DOI: 10.1038/s41596-018-0006-9).
